text:
Jordan (Support): FYI getting multiple reports of p99 spikes & queued requests hitting /v1/generate for a handful of tenants starting ~10:15 PDT. Customers seeing 504s and long tails :frowning:

Ravi (Eng-runtime): Noted. Any tenant IDs or sample request IDs? Is this across models/regions?

Jordan (Support): Tenant: tenant-acme-42. Region us-west1. Appears for both gpt-4-open and gpt-3.5-open. p95 steady, p99 jumps from ~2.2s to 7-8s. No config changes from customer side.

Maya (Eng-SRE): Seeing admission_control queue growth for hostpool us-west1-worker-3 around that window. Inflight concurrency saturated, worker CPU & nvlink queues high. Logs show lots of requests stuck in "admit_wait" path.

Ravi (Eng-runtime): Can you paste a short log snippet? Also any recent deploys?

Maya (Eng-SRE): Paste: ```
[2026-03-16T17:15:23Z] tenant=tenant-acme-42 request_id=abc123 state=admit_wait queue_pos=42
[2026-03-16T17:15:24Z] pool=us-west1-worker-3 inflight=64 limit=64 kv_cache_miss=0
[2026-03-16T17:16:01Z] request_id=abc124 state=processing backend_latency_ms=1200
[2026-03-16T17:16:08Z] request_id=abc125 state=admit_wait queue_pos=59
```
No deploys in last 6h. Infra autoscaler shows no new GPUs added (scaling disabled for maintenance window).

Alex (Eng-platform): Maintenance window? We had scale-down locks for a backup job. That blocked burst autoscale for ~15m starting 10:10 PDT.

Jordan (Support): Customer impact: multiple 504s, logs show client retries piling up. Customer wants ETA.

Ravi (Eng-runtime): Short repro to hit the same path: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-open","input":"test slow path","max_tokens":200}'
```
Run many concurrent (100-200) from one region to reproduce queueing.

Maya (Eng-SRE): Mitigations in order: 1) Lift maintenance lock to allow autoscaler / add warm instances. 2) Increase per-pool concurrency limit temporarily for low-risk tenants. 3) Apply priority routing to move tenant-acme-42 to warmer pool with spare capacity. 4) If saturation persists, enable graceful degrade: route to gpt-3.5-open fallback with token-limit and reduce batch sizes.

Ravi (Eng-runtime): I'll push a short-lived config: bump pool concurrency from 64->80 and move tenant mapping to us-west1-warmpool. Also enable immediate KV cache hotwarm for that tenant.

Alex (Eng-platform): Unlock done. Autoscaler is resuming. Triggering on-demand scale now (+2 GPUs) :rocket:

InfraBot: Autoscaler action: requested 2 nodes for us-west1 at 2026-03-16T17:18:40Z; provisioning started.

Maya (Eng-SRE): After scale/route change, queue depth dropped to single digits within 90s. p99 back to ~2.5s for that tenant. Watching for recurrence.

Jordan (Support): Customer update sent: "We routed your traffic to warm capacity and autoscaling is resuming; we expect full recovery — we're monitoring and will follow up."

Ravi (Eng-runtime): Follow-up actions: - add alert for maintenance locks that block autoscale, - add conservative emergency fallback routing when pool inflight > 80% for >30s, - add tenant waitlist metrics to support dashboard.

Maya (Eng-SRE): Root cause: manual maintenance lock prevented autoscaler from adding capacity during a burst; admission control then queued requests until warm nodes came up.

Jordan (Support): Marking resolved for now. Will reopen if customer sees another regression. :white_check_mark:
